445102.findings: Advance Australia One Penny pattern token; reverse emu and kangaroo with 'LONDON COPY' stamped near the rim, so a modern copy of the 1800s token, not original.
445102.reason: Marked LONDON COPY, a replica worth little.

445103.findings: Tin of mostly gilt/base metal cufflinks and studs, paste stones, mother of pearl; one rose gold stud with seed pearl in a star setting with a worn mark on the backing, probably 9ct.

445103.marks_read: worn stamp on stud back, illegible

445104.findings: About 25 English pennies, mixed Victorian to George V, incl a 1920 penny, plus a few later; copper, green verdigris.

445105.findings: Sterling coins: Victoria veiled head florin or half crown, 1900 shilling, 1906 sixpence, several Victorian threepences/sixpences incl one holed. Silver content plausible for 30.5g but coins worn and one corroded.

445106.findings: Tin of old keys, skeleton, door and clock winding keys, steel and brass.

445107.findings: Jar of Australian halfpennies, kangaroo reverse, George V and VI, 1940s dates seen (1948).

445108.findings: Boxed set of 4 Lindemans Sydney 2000 style pins plus carded London 2012, Sydney 2000 and Melbourne 2006 Commonwealth Games pins.

445109.findings: Two bags of mostly pre-decimal Australian pennies and halfpennies, copper.

445110.findings: Sheets of Swiss francs/rappen and German 2 and 5 mark coins, modern copper-nickel.
445110.reason: Common modern coins, face value only.

445111.findings: Tasmanian souvenir pins, keyrings, Master Cast pewter, Abel Tasman medallion, Bureau of Met centenary pin.

445112.findings: UK 50p and Australian 50c proof coins in World Heritage Sites PNC, Stonehenge/Uluru, numbered 27667, 21 April 2005.

445113.findings: Four Royal Australian Mint uncirculated six-coin year sets, 1982 green wallet among them, others red wallets.

445114.findings: 2020 firefighters Brave $2, 2018 Lest We Forget Eternal Flame $2, 2022 Commonwealth Games $1 coloured coins, carded.

445115.findings: 1991 RAM proof coin set with 25th anniversary of decimal currency 50c, boxed with wallet.

445116.findings: Eight Chinese cash coins on a sheet with Song Dynasty info card, labelled #20; patina visible.
